methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $100M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Ocean Infinity is a Growth-stage ocean and maritime technology company that has raised over $100M in total capital. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of limited public equivalents; only one identified private peer—Orbital Marine Power—provides direct sector reference.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here, using total raised ($100M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-to-later-stage transitions. This yields an implied valuation of $120M. The method reflects the company's progression through funding rounds while acknowledging the relatively nascent data available for frontier maritime technology.

The analysis triangulates to a range of $102M (low) to $138M (high), with a median of $120M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological anchor and limited comparable company reference points in public markets. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of seasoned public comps in ocean tech, the absence of disclosed revenue or EBITDA metrics for peers, and sector-specific regulatory and capital intensity factors that may not map cleanly to other Growth-stage tech valuations. Any forward valuation would benefit from additional revenue-based or contract-value metrics specific to maritime operations and customer concentration data.
